title: Species/geography expansion (root digital twin)
if: we broaden root-behavior modeling beyond 3 Nordic species to more species and soil/climate types
but: calibration cost and data-collection effort rise
badCompromise: Stay at 3 species: deployable, but limited to cities where those species dominate.

title: Cross-program oversight vs. stream autonomy
if: we apply cross-program oversight across the portfolio
badCompromise: Heavy central governance (visibility) or fully independent streams (autonomy).

title: Secure custom app vs. Excel adoption
if: IT builds a secure custom application to replace Excel for sensitive data
then: security improves and data risk decreases
but: the app is too restrictive and users revert to Excel

applications.1: Keep a flexible Excel-like front end; segment sensitive storage into a locked backend.
applications.28: Enforce security through field-level masking/encryption rather than feature lockout.
applications.24: Excel as client, audited connector as intermediary to the secure backend.
applications.32: Change visibility (masking/redaction) rather than removing functionality.
